 ANNEXURE D 
 DISCOUNTS, PAYMENTS AND INVOICING MECHANISM 
 DISCOUNTS: 
 Zameen shall be permitted, at its discretion, to extend a discount of 10% (ten percent) to any Buyer who buys any Unit at 100% (one hundred percent) upfront payment, and a discount of 05% (five percent) to any Buyer who buys any Unit at 50% (fifty percent) upfront payment. 
 
 Zameen shall also be permitted, at its discretion, to extend a further discount of [●] [WORDS] percent ( [●] NUMBERS%) to any Buyer on the sale of any Unit, independent of and/or in addition to the permitted discounts as stated above . 
 PAYMENT: 
 Customer shall pay Zameen Online Marketplace Fee in the following manner: 
 Customer shall pay [●] [WORDS] percent ( [●] NUMBERS%) of Sale Price to Zameen on payment of [●] [WORDS] percent ( [●] NUMBERS%) of Sale Price by the Buyer; 
 
 Customer shall pay a further [●] [WORDS] percent ( [●] NUMBERS%) of Sale Price to Zameen on payment of further [●] [WORDS] percent ( [●] NUMBERS%) of Sale Price by the Buyer, taking the aggregate down payment/instalment(s) to [●] [WORDS] percent ( [●] NUMBERS%) of the Sale Price; 
 
 Customer shall pay a further [ [●] [WORDS] percent ( [●] NUMBERS%) of Sale Price, along with any Premium Fee due under Clause 5.2, to Zameen on payment of further [●] [WORDS] percent ( [●] NUMBERS%) of Sale Price by the Buyer, taking the aggregate down payment/instalment(s) to [●] [WORDS] percent ( [●] NUMBERS %) of the Sale Price. 
 
 Cancelled Unit Fee shall be payable by the Customer as and when a sale may be cancelled. 
 
 In the event that more than 10% (ten percent) of the Sale Price is paid by the Buyer as a single up front down payment/instalment(s), the proportionate Marketing Fee on pro-rata basis shall be paid to Zameen in accordance with Clause 8.1 of this Agreement. 
 
 In the event that any Unit is sold by Zameen at 100% (one hundred percent) upfront payment, Online Market place Fee shall be charged in full at the Sale Price/Quoted Price of the Unit after deduction of applicable discount(s), if any. 
 
 INVOICING MECHANISM : 
 Zameen shall invoice the Customer within 3 (three) days after every sale of a Unit(s), payment of every down payment/instalment(s), and cancellation of sale by the Buyer or for any other fee/payment due to Zameen under this Agreement, as the case may be. Customer shall pay and clear all such invoices, within 3 (three) working days of the date of such invoice, notwithstanding any documents to be filed, submitted and/or completed by the Buyer in respect of the sale of any Unit. 
 
 Customer understands and acknowledges that any dispute or objection in respect of any invoice of Zameen shall be intimated to Zameen in writing within 3 (three) days from the date of invoice. If Zameen does not receive an objection within 3 (three) days from the date of invoice, then it shall be deemed that the Customer accepts the invoice. Moreover, the Customer shall have no right to raise any objection after the lapse of 3 (three) days from the date of invoice. 
 
 Within [ ● ] day(s) of acceptance of the invoice or resolution of any objection under para 8 above, the payments collected from the Buyer(s) shall be disbursed by Zameen Medallion (Private) Limited after adjustment of any Service Fee, Zameen’s Share of Premium and/or any other charges, payments or fees payable to Zameen under this Agreement, as illustrated in para 11 below . All disbursements to the Customer shall be credited to the Customer’s bank account specified in Annexure G (“ Customer’s Bank Account ”). For the avoidance of doubt, adjustment of Service Fee under this clause shall be deemed as full and final settlement of the applicable Service F ee that the Customer is liable to pay to Zameen under this Agreement. 
 
 Customer shall not be liable in any manner for any delay or failure on the part of Zameen with respect to disbursement of Service Fee and/or any other fee/payment due towards Zameen, or any part thereof under this Agreement. 
 
 Any fee(s) or payment to Zameen outstanding at the time of termination of this Agreement shall be paid to Zameen by Customer within seven (7) days of such termination. 
 
 All applicable taxes shall be borne by either party as per local law(s). All invoices generated under this Agreement shall be subject to applicable withholding tax and sales tax. 
 
 Zameen Medallion shall follow the following invoicing and disbursal of payment model: 
 
 
 Note 
 Services Sales Tax under PRA shall be paid by Customer whereas WHT shall be deducted from Zameen’s Service Fee. 
 The transaction explained in the process are for reference purposes only. 
 ANNEXURE E 
 SERVICES 
 
 
 Zameen shall provide IT and IT-enabled services, along with related services, to the Customer during the Service Period of this Agreement, which shall include, but are not limited to: 
 
 Lead generation; 
 Call centre services; 
 Software development; 
 Software maintenance; 
 System integration; 
 Web design; 
 Web development; 
 Web hosting; 
 Utilization of Zameen’s online portal to facilitate the sale of a Unit. 
 Network design; 
 Social media campaigns run on social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, YouTube etc.; and 
 Technical support. 
 
 Zameen shall provide, at its discretion, digital solutions and branding through ATL and BTL activities for the Project. 
 
 Zameen shall collect, for and on behalf of Customer, down payment/instalment(s) up to thirty percent (30%) of the Sale Price from the Buyer of any Unit included in Project’s Inventory and sold or booked during the Service Period or such other time period as may be mutually agreed with respect to the Units’ pending approvals.

 Sales Targets are a periodical average, and in the event that Zameen achieves higher sales than the Sales Targets for the co rresponding period as stated section 1 above , the additional sales shall be counted towards the Sales Target of the following period(s).
